name: Composite "dice" poker chip — Ø40 body, white inlay ring + 6 white edge spots
description: Classic 11.5 g composite dice poker chip: a solid colour disc (built red here; the body colour is set per denomination in-game), a thin white dashed-inlay ring bounding the smooth centre, and six white rectangular edge spots (the 'dice' tabs) evenly spaced around the rim. Dice pips omitted (sub-2 mm). Skin v1 — a CHIP_SKINS registry seam is prepared in code for future designs.

parts.name: Chip disc body (colour = denomination in-game)
parts.note: Ø40 × 3.3 mm composite disc. Built red as a representative colour; in-game the body is recoloured per denomination (white/red/blue/green/black…).

parts.name: Thin white inlay ring bounding the centre
parts.note: Dashed-inlay border read — flat ring (torus axis y) on the top face at the centre/rim boundary.
